name: Texas UIL State Cross Country Championships
where: Round Rock, TX · Old Settlers Park
headline: Texas UIL State Cross Country Championships
summary: Texas is home to No. 3 Southlake Carroll and No. 6 El Paso Eastwood in DyeStat's national boys team rankings, plus top-10 individuals Kai Gutierrez of Southlake Carroll and Noah Garcia of El Paso Eastwood. All six classes race over two days. · Fri–Sat Nov 6–7 · First race 8:15 a.m. CT both days
